SQL:
SELECT DISTINCT cr.node_id,cr.tdocNumber,cr.type,cr.status,cr.summaryOfChange,m.node_id AS meeting_node_id,m.meetingNumberInt AS meetingOrdinal
 FROM CR cr JOIN rel_PRESENTED_AT a ON a.src_id=cr.node_id JOIN Meeting m ON m.node_id=a.dst_id
 WHERE m.canonicalMeetingNumber='RAN3#123' AND cr.type='CR' AND cr.status='agreed'
 ORDER BY m.meetingNumberInt DESC,cr.tdocNumber ASC
